[Data utilities] Reads a 5-field cron expression (or @daily-style macro) and returns the next N run times in UTC and in the given time zone, a plain-English description and the expanded fields. Input: cron, optional tz (default UTC), count 1-20, after. Limits: no seconds field, no L/W/#. Offline.

after.description: Start after this time (ISO 8601 or Unix seconds; default now)

cron.description: 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly, @yearly

tz.description: IANA time zone the schedule runs in (default UTC)

name: cron_next
title: Cron next run times + plain-English description
